entry.title: PREAMP- STRYMON La Brea ___NEW___ preamp from an Echoplex Tape Delay
entry.content:
strymon
$200.00 USD
LA BREA · 
It is not one but 2 preamps from a Echoplex Tape Delay. 
You can run it to hit the faux tape sound to get a tape 
saturation sound (no it does not include a delay circuit, 
for that you need the Strymon Deco) It is really 
a booster.
   CONCLUSION __
If you think it does not fill a hole missing on your 
board you are not alone. I find a few other pres 
pulled from old film cameras much more useful 
in adding a fatter and/or bite to even my clean

Always on with this is a non-starter.

entry.title: OVERDRIVE- THIMBLE WASP FX Black & Blue ___NEW ___ a high gain original ???
entry.content:
THIMBLE WASP EFFECTS
 Black & Blue      
$200.00 USD
Not a lot of info about this Columbus Ohio brand or this product. 
This appears to be their only Overdrive pedal? 
It is a high gain unit. Likely a OpAmp with clipping diodes circuit 
in the vein of a BOSS DS-1?
The layout is Bass, Mids, Treble, Gain and Volume. It has both a boost and footswitch to trigger it on. There is a toggle on the 
side without any info why? My best guess that it flushes 
the toilet on the top floor.
CONCLUSION __
I will assume their claim it is their original take on something 
to fit the genre. That said it sounds at minimum similar to 
a lot of what's out there. I feel there are a lot of high gain OD's/Distortion boxes & even some Fuzz pedals that could 
take it on and at worse be a tie for around $50.00 USD.
The knobs lighting up is needless expense, WTF. 
That said I like it. It has personality.
The company is new and I had a quick listen to their 
other pedals that are indeed worth a deep dive & a Post.

link.title: OVERDRIVE- THIMBLE WASP FX Black & Blue ___NEW ___ a high gain original ???

entry.title: OVERDRIVE- MOSKY AUDIO 1959 Dist. ___NEW___clone Ravenstone 1959 via Marshall
entry.content:
MOSKY AUDIO
1959 Distortion 

$55.00 USD
The Marshall 1959 Super Lead Pedal has been a big success. It really has tried to nail the amp. 
99% of most MIAB pedals literally try to get the heavily processed sound we hear on recordings. Add to that many of these recordings are recording a Marshall that is both heavily modified and then the player has put a dirt pedal like a Fuzz or a Boost or an OD slamming 
the amp. The layout is Volume, Tone, Gain and Tight/high pass filter.   
CONCLUSION __  
The company has made some very usable clones. They never quite 
nail anything though. This they might have as it could well be a 
clone of a clone, the Ravenstone 1959.
All 3 are not like most MIAB pedals with bags of  
boost & gain that a Plexi does not actually have it would not matter 
as neither the original or the clones are how the amp sounds without boosting the amps pre with pedals or mods. In the end however this 
Mosky is subjected to Rocks Golden Rule. 😇 
If it sounds good it is good.😕

$225.00 USD
$160.00 USD

link.title: OVERDRIVE- MOSKY AUDIO 1959 Dist. ___NEW___clone Ravenstone 1959 via Marshall

entry.title: CLIPPER- RECOVERY FX & DEVICES Clipping ___NEW___ damn clever invention
entry.content:
RECOVERY 
EFFECTS & DEVICES
 CLIPPING 
$145.00 USD
I will be straight up & honest. I thought at first hearing about this
it was a cheap gimmick & a total con. In fact laughable. OOPS!
If you are a Fuzz guy you may know that a Germanium Fuzz can sound  
fat and warm and its rich overtones give the treble content dancing 
overtones and rich harmonics. This box simply puts clipping diodes 
across the input signal. There is not any  preamp section to crank the 
signal so it doesn't need  electricity.  A toggle lets you choose between 
a 1N270 or a 1N34A Germanium diode to clip input signal.
CONCLUSION ___
Even going straight into a clean amp gives you a very transparent 
sound with a nice fat breadth to the signal and a bit of bite that 
is very pleasing. The price is a bit of an ouch. I can not help to 
think half of it, perhaps $75 would be fair.

link.title: CLIPPER- RECOVERY FX & DEVICES Clipping ___NEW___ damn clever invention

entry.title: MULTI FX- BOSS EX-4 Effects Expander___ NEW ___ too late? or thank god!!!
entry.content:
BOSS EX-4  
EFFECTS EXPANDER   
$330.00 USD
Is it too little too late or is it thank god we 
have a simple, reliable bulletproof all in one 
affordable complete package to team up with one of the new killer but cheap modelers for 
an amp or to add to our carefully chosen 
gourmet dirt pedals.
It has 128 sounds with 128 memories. 
Delays and Reverbs plus all the classic 
Boss Dirt pedals, Modulation Effects 
plus even those less used FX. With 
4 loaded in at a time you have 
a tune covered. 
 CONCLUSION __  
Other companies no matter how good do 
not have pedal sounds that are so good 
that they have been made for decades. 
You simply get 'the best of'. Add to that 
there are always a buyer for an old Boss 
pedal. This pedal will be a big seller!!!  
      
       

thefineprint
You might recall the Plugout-FX with its 16 FX & the scheme to get you to buy it and pay to download  more sounds had the YouTubers go ballistic as simply a big con. I was half expecting Boss to wait a year & bring out a more typical pedal with these sounds in  it, and it does have them.  All the extras are a form of apology.😇LOL

link.title: MULTI FX- BOSS EX-4 Effects Expander___ NEW ___ too late? or thank god!!!

entry.title: FUZZ- COSMODIO INSTRUMENTS Glitch Witch ... MOSFET Fuzz
entry.content:
C O S M O D I O   I N S T R U M E N T S
GLITCH WITCH    
$280.00 USD
The heart of this is MOSFETS. Often referred to as just a FET.
A FET is a transistor that can be used to emulate a tube. However by adding diodes or simply overloading the 
input it can turn the sound into a Fuzz. In fact so much as 
to head into Tone Bender territory or beyond.
The layout is Volume, Treble, Bass, Gate and Gain. Divide, 
Division and Depth scramble the sound but give you enough 
control to keep musical enough to play a tune or to go into 
Star Wars or Shoegaze city. 
             CONCLUSION __
An impressive mix of controlled and musical sound 
and any level of of chaos. A one size fits all with 
both the benefits and rather obvious handicaps 
all such pedals have.

link.title: FUZZ- COSMODIO INSTRUMENTS Glitch Witch ... MOSFET Fuzz

This one comes from France from a small amp and 
pedal builder. The layout is Volume, Mids, Tone &

be more Gain. A second footswitch, Boost, gives

you love it or give it a pass.

entry.title: OVERDRIVE- BOSS DS-1X Distortion ... a Slingshot Dragster !!!
entry.content:
BOSS  
DS-1X Distortion
$175.00 USD
The original DS-1 has never been out of production and is BOSS's 
biggest selling distortion pedal that whole time.
Its best kept secret is it stated on the breadboard as a RAT pedal,😇. 
There have been 7 basic models and some of them have had a few versions. This came out in 2014.
This one was designed to fix all the problems of the previous 
models and to my ears the problems of those that followed.  
The secret is digital control. Digital is a dirty word. Worse 
still orange pedals are forbidden to be a bit pricey. 
        CONCLUSION __ 
It was nearly discontinued but it became the dirty
pleasure to those that have used their ears & even 
more so when in application. No fizz or buzz. Very 
fat but never muddy in the lows. It has great cut 
without being nasal or having nasty honk. 
It even sounds great at low gain.

link.title: OVERDRIVE- BOSS DS-1X Distortion ... a Slingshot Dragster !!!
